_comment: Exercises coloratt.c match_str2clr() (348-371) and match_str2attr() (373-393) through botl.c parse_status_hl2() and parse_condition(): both compare with fuzzymatch(..., " -_", TRUE), which skips spaces, hyphens and underscores but not a vertical tab or form feed. A colour preceded by a vertical tab is an unknown colour, and an attribute preceded by a form feed is no attribute, so it is tried as a colour and reported twice, where 'Light_Blue' and 'under-line' match. The variation is the condition path, whose attribute loop differs from the field path's.
